claims.description: Name and value pairs that preview the attributes of the credential

revocationRegistryDefinitionId.description: Revocation registry that holds the status of this credential

revocationRegistryIndex.description: Index of this credential in the revocation registry

connectionId.description: An established connection to send the offer on. The agent creates an Out-of-Band invitation when the caller omits it.

autoAccept.description: Complete the issuer steps without a call: the agent issues the credential on `request-received`, with no `acceptCredentialRequest` call.

useLegacyDid.description: Advertise the legacy did:web form when the DID of the agent is did:webvh. The agent ignores it when `connectionId` is present.

didcommVersion.description: DIDComm envelope version of the invitation. Defaults to 'v2' when omitted. The agent ignores it when `connectionId` is present.
